title: Import members
description: Bring members and their parents in from a spreadsheet. A member is found again by their member number, a parent by their email or name; what is not found is added. Filled cells update a person, empty ones leave them as they are, and no accounts are created. Try a file first: the trial changes nothing.

file.title: File
file.description: A CSV file as spreadsheets save it: UTF-8 or Windows-1252, separated by semicolons, commas or tabs, with a header row. Dates as DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.
file.label: CSV file
file.tooLarge: This file is larger than 1 MiB. Split it into smaller files.
file.unreadable: This file cannot be read as a table. Check that it is a CSV file with a header row.
file.sampleHint: A fictional file that shows the format, with German headers.

mapping.title: Columns
mapping.description: Which column fills which field. Columns with known English or German names are matched already; this browser remembers your choices for the next file.
mapping.notesDescription: Each chosen column is added to the member’s notes as a line “Column: value”.
mapping.noFreeColumns: Every column is mapped to a field.
mapping.required: Map at least the member number, the first and the last name, and both names of a parent whose other columns you map.
mapping.mismatch: The columns do not fit the file. Choose the file again.

tryHint: A trial shows what the import would do and changes nothing. Then import the rows without problems.

result.dryDescription: What the import would do. Nothing has been changed yet.
result.appliedDescription: What the import did. It is listed under Import runs.
result.name: Name
result.duplicates: May be the same person as {{names}}

issues.member-no-repeated: An earlier row has this member number.
issues.guardian-ambiguous: Several persons match {{field}}; add their email.
issues.guardian-cycle: {{field}}: the parent is a child of the member.

history.title: Import runs
history.description: Every import, newest first. An import cannot be undone; importing a file again changes only what changed.
history.loadError: Could not load the import runs.
